x: Thanks are again due mainly to Les Cohen (and his wife) who do an enormous amount of work in this connection. We congratulate Les and Mrs. Cohen, not only on the results of their efforts for the Fund, but upon the recent birth of a daughter.
Meanwhile, we report that our finances continue to be in a healthy state. We are again indebted to Les and Mrs. Cohen for their valuable work in connection with the Supporters' Club.

No words of praise can be too high for the work of Les Cohen (and of Mrs. Cohen who has also rendered great assistance) and of the many hundreds of willing supporters who placed us in such a strong position financially.
